description: Defect C: close encryption + urgency + synthetic-only gaps. (1) caseRepository persists gate JSON (gate_decision) with chart citation snippets in PLAINTEXT — encrypt at rest like the packet. (2) Job last_error is plaintext PHI-adjacent — encrypt at rest, decrypt on read. (3) OPEN_FOR_DEADLINE omits 'failed', so a failed-but-unsubmitted case disappears from summary urgent/unknown queues — add 'failed'. (4) Add a synthetic-only guard: refuse the predictable dev key and demo-user seeding when the environment signals non-synthetic/production. Depends on FEAT-001 (migration runner). Independent of B/D/E.
steps: Read server/repositories/caseRepository.ts, server/jobs/jobRunner.ts, server/domain/types.ts, server/config.ts, server/auth/bootstrap.ts, server/repositories/auditRepository.ts (reference for encrypt-at-rest), and their tests first.

In server/repositories/caseRepository.ts encrypt the gate JSON: in updateCase write gate as encryptField(JSON.stringify(gate), this.encKey) into gate_decision (instead of plaintext JSON), and in mapCaseRow parse via JSON.parse(decryptField(row.gate_decision, this.encKey)). decryptField passes through legacy plaintext, so existing rows still read. Mirror exactly how packet is encrypted/decrypted in the same file.

In server/jobs/jobRunner.ts encrypt last_error at rest: in setStatus store encryptField(lastError, this.encKey) when a lastError is present (keep NULL when absent), and in mapRow decrypt it (decryptField, tolerating legacy plaintext) so JobRow.lastError is readable. No new column needed — encrypt into the existing last_error column since decryptField tolerates legacy plaintext.
In server/domain/types.ts add 'failed' to the OPEN_FOR_DEADLINE array so failed-but-unsubmitted cases stay in the summary urgent/unknown deadline queues.

Add a synthetic-only guard. In server/config.ts: when a non-synthetic/production signal is present (NODE_ENV==='production' OR MEDAUTH_PROFILE==='production') AND MEDAUTH_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY is NOT set, throw a clear error from loadConfig refusing to boot with the predictable dev key. Permissive when config.isTest OR explicit local synthetic dev (no production signal). In server/auth/bootstrap.ts: seedUsersIfEmpty refuses to seed demo users (throw a clear error) under the same non-synthetic+no-key condition; permissive under tests / explicit synthetic dev. Keep existing test boot paths (loadConfig({isTest:true}) in app.test.ts) working unchanged.

Add tests: (a) in server/repositories/repositories.test.ts (or db-adjacent) assert the raw gate_decision column value starts with 'enc:v1:' and contains no citation-snippet substring, while getCase returns the parsed gate object. (b) in server/jobs/jobRunner.test.ts assert the raw last_error column is ciphertext (enc:v1:) and mapRow/getJob returns the readable error string. (c) a summary test (server/app.test.ts) where a failed case with a known near deadline appears in urgentDeadlines and a failed case with an unknown deadline appears in unknownDeadlines. (d) a config/bootstrap guard test: the non-synthetic+no-key path throws, and the synthetic/test path is allowed (use resetConfigCache and explicit overrides; do not leak env between tests).
acceptance_criteria: Raw gate_decision column is enc:v1: ciphertext with no plaintext citation snippet; getCase returns the parsed gate.
Raw jobs.last_error column is enc:v1: ciphertext; JobRunner mapRow/getJob returns a readable error.
A failed, unsubmitted case with a known near deadline appears in summary urgentDeadlines; with an unknown deadline appears in unknownDeadlines.
Boot/seed is refused with a clear error under a non-synthetic/production signal when MEDAUTH_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset; permitted under tests and explicit local synthetic dev.
All existing tests (including app.test.ts seeded-user login) remain green.
findings: Implemented at L3 (test-verified). Changes: (1) server/repositories/caseRepository.ts updateCase now writes gate as encryptField(JSON.stringify(gate), encKey) into gate_decision; mapCaseRow decrypts via JSON.parse(decryptField(row.gate_decision, encKey)) — decryptField passes through legacy plaintext so existing rows still read. (2) server/jobs/jobRunner.ts setStatus encrypts last_error (encryptField when present, NULL when absent); mapRow decrypts (decryptField, tolerates legacy plaintext) into JobRow.lastError. No new column — reused existing last_error column. (3) server/domain/types.ts OPEN_FOR_DEADLINE now includes 'failed' so failed-but-unsubmitted cases stay in summary urgent/unknown queues. (4) Synthetic-only guard: server/config.ts loadConfig throws 'Refusing to boot' when a production signal (NODE_ENV==='production' OR MEDAUTH_PROFILE==='production') is set without MEDAUTH_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY; server/auth/bootstrap.ts seedUsersIfEmpty throws 'Refusing to seed' under the same condition. NOTE for later steps: the guard keys ONLY on the production signal + missing key — test-ness (VITEST/isTest) does NOT exempt it, because VITEST is always set during the test run and an isTest exemption would make the guard unreachable/meaningless. The existing test harness (loadConfig({isTest:true}) in app.test.ts) stays permissive because it sets no production signal. Tests added: repositories.test.ts asserts raw gate_decision is enc:v1: ciphertext with no citation snippet and round-trips the gate; jobRunner.test.ts asserts raw last_error is enc:v1: ciphertext while getJob returns readable error; app.test.ts summary test seeds two 'failed' cases (known near deadline -> urgentDeadlines, unknown deadline -> unknownDeadlines) via ctx.services.cases; new server/config.guard.test.ts covers throw/permissive paths with env save/restore + resetConfigCache (no env leak). Verification run from worktree root: `npx vitest run server`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` all green — 148 passed, 1 skipped (baseline was 133 passed, 1 skipped), Node v24 (check:node passed). No existing tests weakened or deleted.
